summary: This 6-K filing by Ferrari N.V. (NYSE: RACE) merely furnishes a press release announcing the multi-year renewal of a Formula 1 driver agreement between Scuderia Ferrari HP and Charles Leclerc. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. It is a routine current report of a contractual renewal. Because the filing does not describe a special situation as defined, it is classified as None with high confidence.
